title: Equator design-repo PageSpec
description: Machine contract for a page composition (pageSpecVersion 2.0.0). `mode` (clone|generation) is required; its consequences are enforced by semantic_validate.py. Per-section-type node schemas are closed if/then branches. x-maxWords annotations are enforced by semantic_validate.py.

mode.description: clone = faithful Equator reconstruction (real assets/copy allowed as evidence); generation = a new page for another brand: semantic_validate.py rejects every Equator brand, person, customer, copy, claim, URL, embed and asset (GENERATION_MODE_* rules).

theme.description: Optional; defaults to the manifest defaultTheme. Validated semantically (TOKEN_THEME_COMBINATION).

retrievalEligible.description: Optional echo of the contract flag; must equal the pinned value (RETRIEVAL_ELIGIBILITY_PIN).
